summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data prep, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, deployment, and monitoring—at scale, whereas a model API (e.g., OpenAI or Anthropic) simply returns inference results without ownership of training or infrastructure. You need a full platform when you train or fine-tune custom models, require reproducibility and governance, serve models at production scale, or must keep data in-house; a model API suffices when you only need inference from an existing hosted model. The landscape is dominated by the three hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) plus Databricks, with specialized MLOps and AutoML tools clustering closely behind.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute instance-hour plus storage and endpoint usage; no upfront fees
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams building and deploying custom models with deep control over infrastructure

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go on underlying Azure compute/storage; no additional platform charge
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft ecosystem needing governance and responsible AI integration

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/node-hour, training units, and prediction requests
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting highly automated, managed pipelines and access to Google's Gemini models

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based Databricks Units (DBUs) plus underlying cloud compute; subscription tiers available
platforms.best_for: Data-heavy organizations wanting a unified, multi-cloud lakehouse for data and ML

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based paid plans; enterprise self-hosted licensing
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking across any stack

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and business analysts wanting automated model building with strong governance

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and LLM Studio
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting open-source-rooted AutoML and generative AI with flexible deployment

platforms.name: Amazon Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per token/inference, with provisioned throughput options
platforms.best_for: Teams building generative AI apps on AWS without managing model infrastructure

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free open-source; cost is underlying Kubernetes infrastructure
platforms.best_for: Platform teams wanting portable, Kubernetes-native ML workflows across environments

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; free starter credits
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting fast, serverless GPU execution for training and inference without infra management
